headline: Nifty Set for Lower Open Following Sharp Rally
summary: India's Nifty index is expected to lose around 170 points at the open following a sharp rally, while Infosys ADR closed higher despite a selloff in Nasdaq.
why: Index futures and pre-open indications reflect immediate sentiment shifts and profit-taking after strong market run-ups.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Pre-open indications point to a loss of around 170 points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Pre-market indicators point to a correction as investors book profits following a sharp prior rally.
